question: Does a coolant-only response model trained on the original constant-load trajectory generalize to matched-current-temperature states reached by different preconditioning paths?
status: fixed before any new FMU preconditioning or step branch
match_rule: Using only preconditioning trajectories, choose the first candidate target for which every profile has an eligible sample within plus/minus 0.1 C. Within each profile choose the eligible sample with smallest absolute target error, breaking ties by earliest time. If none of the candidate targets matches all profiles, report feasibility failure and do not run step branches.
profile_power_rule: Each scheduled power applies uniformly to all 44 racks during intervals beginning at or after the listed time. Every selected branch state must have current all-rack power 10.86 kW.
early_initialization_caveat: Preconditioning includes the FMU cold-start transient; retain all traces and report if matching relies on that transient. Do not alter profiles after seeing branch responses.

branch_protocol.effect_definition: step branch minus matched no-step branch, restored from the same saved FMU state

frozen_model.predictor: initial rack 1 coolant temperature C only
frozen_model.method: ridge with alpha 1.0, predictor standardized over all eight original states, unpenalized intercept; no refitting on off-trajectory data
frozen_model.curve_target: rack 1 step-minus-control temperature at each 20 s elapsed sample over 0-3600 s
frozen_model.training_reference: Original eight-state leave-one-out coolant-only final/peak MAE 0.229964/0.197591 C; use as descriptive reference, not pass threshold

predeclared_primary_metrics: signed and absolute frozen-model error for 3600 s paired rack 1 increment
signed and absolute frozen-model error for paired rack 1 window peak
full predicted and observed paired rack 1 curves and their time-averaged absolute and maximum absolute errors
predeclared_secondary_metrics: absolute rack 1 step-branch peak and its time
paired rack 1 time of window maximum, marked censored if at 3600 s
current rack 1 one-tick slope and all CDU primary supply/return and primary-flow state
all 44 rack coolant, power, FMU heat input, and all 44 CDU primary supply/return trajectories
CDU 1 primary supply/return paired peaks and extrema
repeat-run byte identity and maximum numeric variation
interpretation: Matching rack 1 coolant and current power isolates a transfer test for that predictor, not a causal attribution to slope, CDU state, or history. Publish every residual. Do not infer history dependence or scheduler benefit. No result-dependent pass threshold.
stop_gate: Stop after reporting this off-trajectory generalization test; do not change Task 1.5, begin Task 1.6, run history matching, or start scheduling/RL work.
